string.text: A tale at the counter. A tipsy visitor let slip someone else's stash to the barman, who remembered the place: marked on the PDA.
A rumour from the bar "Radar-1": someone left a box here and never came back.
A fight in the bar: %s and %s went at each other: chairs and glasses broken, the repairs took %s RU from the till. The bar's name has suffered.
A quarrel in the bar: %s and %s grabbed each other, but the barman sat them at different tables. No shots fired.
A spree. A squad back from the North with loot drank till morning: +%s RU in the till, and people talk about the bar.
A gift. A regular left the group a "thanks for the shelter": %s, in the shelter's stash.
A gift. A regular left the group a "thanks for the shelter": %s RU in the till.
A wounded man at the door: %s crawled to the bar, covered in blood. Shov stitched him up: he paid %s RU, and his mates won't forget it.
A wounded man at the door: %s crawled to the bar, covered in blood. Nobody could help: he died on the doorstep. The shelter needs a medic.
Shurup is on a binge. Bottles gone from the store: %s. The workshop is closed for another %s hours.
